[[File:3JediTemples.jpg|thumb|300px|Jedi Temple (three types)]]
Various '''Jedi temples''' were established during conflicts throughout the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|history]] by allies of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], including the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal Naboo]] Forces, the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]].

==History==
These Jedi Temples were created by various factions to gain access to Jedi; its [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] counterpart was the [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith Temple]]. The [[Jedi temple (Alaris Prime)|temple]] on [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] was another prominent Jedi Temple that was built during the [[Alaris Prime colonial war|colonial war]] of [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a Jedi Temple was situated in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel-aligned]] city of [[Reytha Minor]] on [[Reytha]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] built a temple on [[Hanoon]] during the [[Battle of Hanoon|liberation]] of the colony. He used it to store the [[Vor'Na'Tu]], but subsequently destroyed the [[Jedi artifact/Legends|Jedi artifact]] after Imperial forces raided the temple.

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi Temples are constructable buildings used for training Jedi in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.
